visibleDestination.description: Callers receive the committed grant/expiry or revoke outcome directly; no TCGplayer credential or custody payload is stored.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Mint and unpair respond only after grant COMMIT acknowledgement. Indeterminate commits return 503, never a success snapshot or a no-write promise.

visibleDestination.description: Held-set resolution returns a read-only resolution snapshot, preview returns the server-resolved plan snapshot, and confirm and recovery commands return the directly persisted Scope Sync Batch snapshot before the route redirects to the same batch page, whose loader reads those same Catalog-owned batch tables. Count quote/acquire return their authoritative quote/outcome directly to the page; retained quote reload reads the same append-only count history. Staging count-capture steps return the run stage they appended, read back from the same append-only capture history.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The held-set route performs no write and returns the complete batched observation/mapping resolution directly. Other API paths respond from the freshly resolved preview or the batch/unit rows written by the command. The admin route uses those responses directly and reloads the same direct read model after confirm, cancel, resume, or retry; no projection-backed read is involved. Count quote responds after persistence; acquire commits its debit before send and returns complete only after result persistence, or a failed/uncertain outcome. The count action renders that response directly; reload derives outcomes and cross-quote reuse from the same authoritative history. Each capture step responds with the stage it committed, and the initial notice is read back from the capture history after its append.

visibleDestination.description: Provider refresh schedule pause/resume return the updated schedule row and run-now returns the per-provider run result; the providers surface then reloads the schedule read directly from the same catalog_provider_refresh_schedule table the command mutated, so no projection lag exists on the visible destination.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Pause and resume respond with the UPDATE ... RETURNING schedule row and run-now responds with the synchronous refresh result; the schedule list read is a direct read of the mutated table, never a projection. bounded-contexts/catalog/features/provider-scope-discovery/api/runtime.db.test.ts proves a pause is visible on the immediately following schedule list read and that run outcomes land on the schedule row before the command returns.

visibleDestination.description: Catalog admin model API commands stay on the operator surface and return command-owned id/version/status plus the committed aggregate snapshot; bulk preview returns the computed preview snapshot and bulk confirm returns the durable authoring job snapshot without waiting on admin detail/list projections.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The issue-owned routes respond from the command handler's evolved aggregate state, the bulk lifecycle preview result, or the authoring job enqueue result. Tests prove stale projection detail reads are not consulted after a command snapshot and that lifecycle and bulk preview/confirm responses carry the committed or durable snapshot needed for the operator UI.

visibleDestination.description: Catalog Item API commands stay on the operator item surface and return command-owned id/version/status plus the committed aggregate snapshot; bulk preview returns the computed preview snapshot and bulk confirm returns the durable authoring job snapshot without waiting on item list/detail projections.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Catalog Item command routes respond from the command handler's evolved aggregate state via commandSnapshotResponse. Bulk preview routes respond from the computed preview result, and bulk confirm routes respond from the authoring job enqueue snapshot. Tests prove stale item detail reads are not consulted after command snapshots and preview/confirm responses carry the snapshot needed for operator UI.

visibleDestination.description: Product Contents authoring stays on the Catalog Item detail surface and returns the resolved Product Contents fact snapshot from the command runtime without waiting on the forward/reverse read-model projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Product Contents replace and remove routes return the resolved fact built by the Product Contents runtime in the same request. The Catalog Item detail UI refreshes Product Contents rows after the authoritative command response, while the projection catches up for forward and reverse lookup rows.

visibleDestination.description: Source Observation workbench mutations return scoped job, review, Catalog sync scope preview/run/state, candidate generation, merge-candidate command payload preview, import preview, impact, and provider-profile snapshots to the same operator workflow; durable job event streams correct later progress without requiring an immediate projection-backed refresh.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Bulk review, integration job, promotion review, provider profile, candidate generation, merge-candidate review command payload preview, and observation review routes return the durable job/profile/review/preview/candidate snapshot produced by the command service in the same request. Catalog sync scope preview returns the computed provider participation preview snapshot without enqueuing a provider job. Catalog sync scope run enqueue returns the durable parent run snapshot with selected provider-unit snapshots and child fan-out links. Catalog sync scope state returns the durable per-scope-per-provider-unit sync state snapshot read directly from catalog_scope_sync_state, the same table the fan-out and worker completion/failure hooks upsert into, so the response is never behind the write it reflects. Candidate generation returns the generated merge-candidate snapshot correlated to the requested sync run or scope. Merge-candidate review command previews return the exact split/update route and body payload from the candidate review row, and the submitted command routes return the command-owned candidate snapshot. Route tests cover Catalog sync scope preview/run/state, job enqueue/lifecycle snapshots, provider profile lifecycle responses, review command snapshots, candidate generation service wiring, merge-candidate command payload previews, and preview/impact responses.

exception.reason: Source Observation control-plane telemetry records redaction-safe operator evidence and returns only an acknowledgement; no user-visible workbench read depends on the POST result. bounded-contexts/catalog/features/source-observations/api/route-modules/route-review-controls.test.ts proves supported telemetry is recorded and unsupported/private telemetry labels are rejected before recording.

visibleDestination.description: The Catalog shell client feeds Source Observation workbench actions from scoped API snapshots and uses durable job event streams to correct projection-backed job progress after writes.

proof.fallback: The client parses initial command-owned job/profile/review/preview snapshots, reconnects durable job streams with last-event-id, retries transient 429/503 stream overloads, and treats sync.required.snapshot as the authoritative durable job snapshot when a stream cannot replay all events. Non-stream workbench commands return the same scoped API snapshot directly.

visibleDestination.description: The admin integrations route action returns same-page command results for daily workbench actions and redirects provider/governance actions with the command-owned feedback context instead of depending on an immediate stale projection read.

proof.authoritativeResponse: integrationsAction dispatches CatalogIntegrationsCommandResult snapshots from command handlers; promotion execution re-previews live context to suppress stale preview submissions, durable job commands return job ids/status, and actions clear stale preview/job context when a new command snapshot supersedes it.

visibleDestination.description: The alias-review workspace accept/reject/revoke actions stay on the daily integrations surface and return the committed #1905 Catalog Alias aggregate snapshot (review status and version per alias hash); the next loader re-reads the alias-review read model so the operator never sees a stale candidate row after a review write.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The alias-review POST /commands route dispatches the #1905 AcceptCatalogAlias/RejectCatalogAlias/RevokeCatalogAlias aggregate commands keyed by alias hash with the operator as actor, and responds from the command handler's evolved aggregate state (reviewStatus + version per applied alias hash). The client dispatchCatalogAliasReviewCommand returns that committed snapshot directly, and the daily route action result stays on the import-to-promotion surface so the next loader re-reads the alias-review read model.

visibleDestination.description: The #3820 attention-queue dismiss/defer/restore actions stay on the daily integrations surface and return the committed attention-dismissal aggregate snapshot (disposition + version per item key); the next loader re-reads the attention-queue read model so a parked item never re-appears (and a restored/aged-back item re-appears) without a stale row.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The attention-queue POST /commands route dispatches the DismissAttentionItem/DeferAttentionItem/RestoreAttentionItem aggregate commands keyed by the item key with the operator as actor, and responds from the command handler's evolved aggregate state (disposition + version). The client dispatchCatalogAttentionQueueCommand returns that committed snapshot directly, and the daily route action result stays on the import-to-promotion surface so the next loader re-reads the attention-queue read model.

visibleDestination.description: #3797 unmapped-scope inbox and coverage matrix accept/reject/revoke/propose actions stay on the scope coverage detail surface and return the committed Provider Scope Mapping aggregate snapshot (reviewStatus + version); the page calls refresh() to re-read the coverage matrix / inbox read model after every write, so the operator never sees a stale row.

proof.authoritativeResponse: POST /commands dispatches AcceptProviderScopeMapping/RejectProviderScopeMapping/RevokeProviderScopeMapping keyed by mapping id with the operator as actor and responds from the command handler's evolved aggregate state; POST /propose dispatches ProposeProviderScopeMapping and optionally an immediate AcceptProviderScopeMapping, returning the final committed snapshot. Both client wrappers (dispatchProviderScopeMappingReviewCommand, proposeProviderScopeMapping) return that snapshot directly, and the inbox/coverage-detail pages call refresh() afterward to re-read the read model.

visibleDestination.description: The Scope Detail language-editions section's accept/reject/defer/revoke actions stay on the scope-detail page and return the committed Catalog Alias aggregate command result (status, intent, outcome); the next loader re-reads the alias-review read model scoped to this scope's reference record, so the operator never sees a stale candidate after a review write.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The scope-detail route action dispatches the AcceptCatalogAlias/RejectCatalogAlias/RevokeCatalogAlias aggregate commands through the same alias-equivalence command endpoint the generic alias-review table uses, and returns the command outcome directly; defer is acknowledged without an aggregate write. The route stays on the scope-detail page after every command, so a full navigation re-runs the loader against the same scope.

visibleDestination.description: Scope-home attention and general alias actions return the shared command result directly and the next loader re-reads the queue and alias read models, while scope pagination remains intact when either supplementary read is unavailable.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The scope-home action delegates to the existing permission-guarded Catalog dispatcher; dismiss/defer/restore and alias accept/reject/revoke return committed command outcomes, and the route revalidates against the same Catalog read endpoints after submission.
